title: Agent Certificate v0 Client-Local Evidence Manifest
description: SCHEMA-1 fixed client-local evidence manifest. G1's root digest is role-separated: `sha256:` plus lowercase SHA-256 over UTF8(`traigent.agent_certificate.client_evidence_manifest_root.v1`) || 0x00 || jcs_v1(this document). The four fixed slots never cross the Backend boundary in full; only this root digest crosses. For sha256_secret_blinded_v1, each slot_commitment_digest keeps the unchanged HMAC formula UTF8("traigent.cert.v0.slot_commitment.v1") || 0x00 || UTF8(artifact_kind) || 0x00 || jcs_v1(artifact_document), keyed by its unique client-local 32-byte blind. No blind, private artifact content, counts, names, paths, or free text is representable.

AgentRevisionSlotV0.description: The agent_revision slot: a sha256_secret_blinded_v1 commitment to the client-local agent revision manifest (parallel to, but distinct from, certificate_registry_agent_revision_v0_schema.json's server-registered AgentRevisionRegistryRecordV0 — that record commits at the SERVER after a separate registration call; this slot is the CLIENT's own local commitment, folded into the evidence-manifest root). The blind and artifact_document remain client-local and are never wire fields.

EvaluationDatasetSlotV0.description: The evaluation_dataset slot: a sha256_secret_blinded_v1 commitment to the client-local evaluation-dataset content used in this build session. Row content, row counts, and dataset identifiers stay client-local; only this slot's digest is representable here. The blind and artifact_document remain client-local and are never wire fields.

EvaluatorSlotV0.description: The evaluator slot: a sha256_secret_blinded_v1 commitment to the client-local evaluator (scoring logic, prompts, or judge configuration) used in this build session. Evaluator source and configuration stay client-local; only this slot's digest is representable here. The blind and artifact_document remain client-local and are never wire fields.

BuildProcessEvidenceSlotV0.description: The build_process_evidence slot: a sha256_secret_blinded_v1 commitment to whatever client-local build-process evidence the client attestor gathered for this session (e.g. the pre-issuance audit report's inputs — certificate_audit_report_v0_schema.json — before that report itself is hashed and bound as certificate evidence). Content stays client-local; only this slot's digest is representable here. The blind and artifact_document remain client-local and are never wire fields.

ClientEvidenceManifestV0.description: The fixed four-slot client-local evidence manifest. This object's own canonical digest (jcs_v1, i.e. traigent_schema/fp2.py) is the value that crosses the Backend boundary as claim G1's manifest_root_digest — never this object itself.
